tasks.subject: Task 12: Stop reloading the whole slot every frame
tasks.description: drawChainEdit re-reads the slot every frame (~12 reads, ~34ms on a full chain). Cache per slot and invalidate on every chain edit path. Acceptance: reads per frame do not scale with chain length (measure with a counting getSlotParam, as Task 4 did); prove invalidation is complete against the implementer's enumerated edit-path list.
